sources.label: US Naval Institute · Ensign Frank Marble, The Battle of the Yalu, July 1895

note: The contemporary US Naval Institute account identifies Yoshino, Naniwa, Takachiho and Akitsushima as protected cruisers in the Japanese van at the Yalu. That component supports the anonymous protected-cruiser illustration. Chinese ironclads, other cruiser types, gunboats and transports are not reconstructed, and the event-level asset does not create identified armies or imply either fleet was homogeneous.
